items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Bobby Williams was working with -- with the -- at the Sunset with Cat Correll Dickerson

ctx.x: She had the group, and then when she left, then we turned it over, had a fellow named Wilson, was a very good trumpet player, young fellow. We all was young. Then we got a drummer from Louisville named Burton because Bobby Williams was working with -- with the -- at the Sunset with Cat Correll Dickerson, with -- beautiful trumpet player. Bobby, his name was in that book, but when you ever heard him play, Roy Eldridge (unintelligible) was just a replica of what Bobby Williams was.
